artists.biography:
Crippled Black Phoenix is a rock supergroup from the United Kingdom. Several musicians have contributed to Crippled Black Phoenix's albums and play with them during their live shows.

Members of the band used to play in other bands (including Iron Monkey, Gonga, Mogwai, Electric Wizard and others). In 2004, Justin Greaves began recording primitive sounds he had in mind for years. He was encouraged by Dominic Aitchison, and their ideas would lay the backbone for Crippled Black Phoenix.
Although originally having an unorthodox start, since all the band members were part of and busy with other projects at the time of the band's founding, Crippled Black Phoenix remained committed to staying together and forged their sound. The band writes what they call "endtime ballads," signifying both the slightly macabre nature of their songs and their unusual blend of styles as the final evolution in music. This blend has led to them being called everything from stoner-prog to freak-folk to doom.

Crippled Black Phoenix have made live shows a focus and have performed in unusual venues, using Victorian-era instruments in tandem with more modern instruments.

perplexity.description:
Ellengæst is a 2020 post-rock album by UK band Crippled Black Phoenix, released through Season of Mist. The record marked a transitional period for the group, with founder and drummer Justin Greaves announcing a new era for the band and giving greater prominence to vocalist Belinda Kordic while the band searched for a new co-singer. The album features an expanded roster of guest vocalists, including Vincent Cavanagh of Anathema, Jonathan Hultén of Tribulation, Ryan Patterson of Fotocrime, and Gaahl of Gaahls Wyrd, alongside solo vocalist Suzie Stapleton.

Musically, Ellengæst blends post-rock with influences drawn from the band's metal heritage, despite the absence of metal instrumentation in the actual compositions. The album spans 54 minutes across eight tracks, incorporating diverse sonic textures through keyboards handled by Helen Stanley—ranging from piano and organ to synthesizers—alongside guitar work from Greaves and Andy Taylor. The guest vocalists bring varied stylistic perspectives, spanning death/doom, gothic metal, electronic post-punk, black metal, and indie rock.

The album received recognition within the metal press, with Metal Hammer naming it the 43rd best metal album of 2020. It represents a notable entry in Crippled Black Phoenix's discography, which had been active since 2004, and established the band's direction following the lineup changes announced that summer.
